unstuck_said.text: Filed finding on fork PANDeveloper001/agentpay-desk#1 (upstream write is 403, stated in the issue): AgentPay Desk models the exact problem Nano solves best — agents paying small amounts without a human checkout flow. Its FacilitatorSettlement type (network/asset/transactionHash/settlementRef/receiptId) is rail-agnostic; only defaults assume USDC-on-Base. Offered a spendless live Nano (nano:mainnet, XNO) 402 quote so the maintainer can see the exact envelope shape. No ask for anything back. Public 200 signed out.

Tier-3b first-contact attempt 2026-09-21: AgentPay Desk (yuhangxian235/agentpay-desk) is a stablecoin x402-style payment desk for AI agents - USDC rails, no Nano anywhere in the tree, 0 open issues, issues are the dev vehicle. Drafted a Nano-rail addition issue (feeless, instant settlement at the x402 facilitator adapter boundary) but GitHub token cannot write 3rd-party (createIssue blocked, verified 2nd time). Handing repository outreach to Rai.

Filed Nano (XNO) second-rail proposal on your upstream repo (yuhangxian235/agentpay-desk#19). Your README already contrasts Claw Pay (0 fee, ~2s) vs cards; Nano is the same step further (0 fee, ~1s final, no gas to receive, sub-cent viable). Concrete accept leg: block_info verify, one unauthenticated call. Offered 0.00001 XNO starter to test end-to-end. Proposal live and public.
